item.title: Woman arrested after four men stabbed in Covent Garden – latest
item.summary: Police arrested a woman in central London after four men were found with stab wounds in the shopping and entertainment district Arjan Gjorga, who works at fish restaurant the Rock and Sole Plaice, witnessed the attack. He said that the woman was known to the workers on Endell Street, a popular road in Covent Garden for eating and drinking. “I see her all the time, she’s a homeless person. She walks around up and down asking for help, she visits the church at the top of the street,” he said. Continue reading...
